title: The Gifted pupil in the class
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：gifted　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gifted 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the fisherman wrote of ① a gifted pupil in the class in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② more gifted than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the gifted ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most gifted pupil in the class anybody in the harbour had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too gifted to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the gifted ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a gifted ear for music, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as gifted as the ear for music they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was gifted or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something gifted, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite gifted; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the gifted ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, year after year, she wrote of another gifted pupil in the class in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more gifted than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most gifted ear for music in the whole harbour, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the gifted ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有天赋（前置定语 a gifted pupil in the class：1963 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件有天赋的学生）
B. adj. 有天赋／才华出众（比较级 more gifted than：文中两处，一处比班上有天赋的学生，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有天赋／才华出众（最高级 the most gifted：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有天赋（表语 too gifted to do：母亲觉得它太有天赋，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 才华出众（前置定语 a gifted ear for music：叔叔把整件事称作一桩才华出众的乐感）
F. adj. 才华出众（同级比较 as gifted as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩天生的乐感相比）
G. adj. 才华出众（后置定语 something gifted：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 才华出众（受程度副词修饰 quite gifted：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a gifted pupil in the class
the most gifted pupil in the class anybody
The most gifted ear for music in

answers.why: gifted 意为“有天赋”，1963 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件有天赋的学生”，此处作前置定语 a gifted pupil in the class。
gifted 意为“有天赋”，此处用比较级 more gifted than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
gifted 意为“有天赋”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说它是渔港里最有天赋的一件，故用最高级 the most gifted pupil in the class。
gifted 意为“有天赋”，母亲认为这件东西“太有天赋了，谁也用不上”，too gifted to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
gifted 意为“才华出众”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩才华出众的乐感”，此处作前置定语 a gifted ear for music。
gifted 意为“才华出众”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩天生的乐感一样才华出众”，同级比较用 as gifted as。
gifted 意为“才华出众”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“才华出众的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something gifted。
gifted 意为“才华出众”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当才华出众”，quite 修饰原级 gifted。
gifted 意为“才华出众”，1973 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要才华出众”，故用比较级 more gifted than。
gifted 意为“才华出众”，母亲 1975 年说的是“整个渔港里最才华出众的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most gifted ear for music。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件有天赋的学生。（a gifted pupil in the class）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有天赋。（more gifted than …）
母亲觉得它太有天赋，谁也用不上。（too gifted to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩才华出众的乐感。（a gifted ear for music）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩天生的乐感一样才华出众。（as gifted as …）
到了 1970 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件才华出众的东西。（something gifted）
answers: In 1963 the fisherman wrote of a gifted pupil in the class in the logbook.
Everybody said it was more gifted than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too gifted to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a gifted ear for music.
He said nobody would call it as gifted as the ear for music they had once had.
By 1970 the logbook asked for nothing but something gifted.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 gifted 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the fisherman wrote of a gifted pupil in the class in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most gifted pupil in the class in the harbour, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too gifted to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a gifted ear for music, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite gifted, and everybody laughed.
The gifted ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
